lead.headline: Record ETF exodus keeps bitcoin pinned below $60,000
lead.standfirst: Investors pulled about $570 million from US spot bitcoin funds on Monday, taking November's outflows to a record, and the price failed to follow stocks higher on Tuesday.
body: US spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded about $570 million of net outflows on Monday, The Block reported, confirming early aggregator estimates. CoinDesk put November's total withdrawals at a record $4.71 billion, while The Block said the month's tally was nearing $5 billion.

Bitcoin traded near $59,470 on Kraken at 16:33 UK, about 1.5% below the morning edition and under $60,000 for most of the day, after a 24-hour low of about $59,310. CoinDesk reported that liquidations tripled as the coin handed back all of Monday's Nvidia-driven gains.

The weakness came even as wider markets rose. The Conference Board said its US consumer confidence index jumped to 103.3 in November from 91.9, its highest since January 2025 and well above the 92.5 economists expected, according to Finwire. CoinDesk reported that the stock rally failed to budge crypto.
Zcash fared worse. ZEC fell to about $712 on Kraken, roughly 7% below the morning edition, a day after Grayscale's new leveraged Zcash fund dropped more than 13% on its debut.
Attention now turns to Wednesday, when US PCE inflation and a revised estimate of third-quarter growth are due at 13:30 UK, before US markets close on Thursday for Thanksgiving.

headline: Monday's $570 million bitcoin ETF outflow is confirmed, taking November to a record, and bitcoin sits near $59,470 despite a US stock rally. ZEC slid about 7% to near $712.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, afternoon edition. US spot bitcoin funds lost about five hundred and seventy million dollars on Monday, confirming this morning's early figures and taking November's outflows to a record near four point seven billion. Bitcoin is near fifty-nine thousand, five hundred dollars, still below sixty thousand, even though US stocks rose after a strong consumer confidence reading. Zcash slid about seven percent since this morning to around seven hundred and twelve dollars. Next up is US inflation data at half past one tomorrow afternoon, UK time. The next red event is the Fed decision on the ninth of December at seven in the evening. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Monday's $570 million ETF outflow confirmed; November a record
stories.why: This morning's figure came only from aggregators; The Block has now confirmed about $570 million of net outflows from US spot bitcoin ETFs on Monday. CoinDesk put November's outflows at a record $4.71 billion, so fund holders are still steadily selling into weakness.
stories.caveat: Monthly totals differ: CoinDesk says $4.71 billion, The Block says nearing $5 billion.

note.read: Sustained fund selling is the clearest source of pressure on bitcoin this month, and it has not let up.
note.alt: Part of the outflow may be hedge funds unwinding basis trades rather than investors giving up on bitcoin.
note.change: A run of inflow days, or outflows shrinking sharply before Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Bitcoin stays below $60,000 as stocks rally without it
stories.why: Kraken showed bitcoin near $59,470 at 16:33 UK, down from about $60,380 at the morning edition, with a 24-hour low near $59,310. The new evidence is that the US open did not help: CoinDesk reported the stock rally failed to budge crypto, and that liquidations tripled as Monday's gains were handed back.

note.read: Bitcoin is trading on its own weak flows rather than on the wider risk mood, which is unusual.
note.alt: Crypto may simply lag, catching up with stocks if the rally holds into Wednesday's data.
note.change: A firm move back above $62,000 would suggest the decoupling is fading.

stories.title: ZEC slides about 7% to near $712
stories.why: Kraken showed ZEC near $712 at 16:33 UK, down from about $764 at the morning edition and from about $775 at the start of the 24-hour window, with a low near $708. The new evidence is that the slide sped up after Grayscale's leveraged Zcash fund fell 13% on its debut; no single new Zcash-specific cause was found.
stories.caveat: Price from one exchange's data; no outlet has explained today's move.

note.read: ZEC is falling faster than bitcoin, as it tends to when risk appetite drains.
note.alt: Hedging or early selling around the new leveraged fund may be adding pressure.
note.change: ZEC steadying while bitcoin stays weak would suggest the selling is exhausted.

stories.title: US consumer confidence jumps to 103.3, highest since January 2025
stories.why: The Conference Board's index rose to 103.3 in November from 91.9, far above the 92.5 expected, according to Finwire. It lifted US stocks, but crypto did not follow, a sign bitcoin's problem today is its own flows rather than the economy.

stories.title: US moves to forfeit $1.1 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
stories.why: The Justice Department filed to forfeit about $1.1 billion in USDC stolen in North Korea's Binance hack, CoinDesk and Decrypt reported, while other stolen funds keep moving. Recovered funds reduce the risk of the hackers dumping coins on the market.

stories.title: South Korea drafts bill to end its ICO ban and back bank-led stablecoins
stories.why: A draft South Korean crypto bill would lift the 2017 ban on token sales, let bank-led groups issue won stablecoins and cap any shareholder's stake in a crypto exchange at 20%, CoinDesk, The Block and Cointelegraph reported. Korea is one of the biggest retail crypto markets, so it matters for wider demand over time.

explained.title: Why ETF outflows can weigh on price
body: A spot bitcoin ETF holds real bitcoin for its shareholders. When more money leaves a fund than arrives, the fund usually has to sell bitcoin to pay those investors back, so a long run of net outflows adds steady selling to the market.
That is why daily flow figures are watched so closely: they show whether big, slower-moving investors are adding or cutting exposure, which can matter more than any single day's headline.

investigating: Is anything Zcash-specific behind today's sharper ZEC fall? Evidence: exchange notices, Zcash forum posts, or flows into Grayscale's Zcash funds.
Will ETF outflows ease before Thanksgiving? Evidence: Tuesday and Wednesday flow figures from The Block or Farside.
